about.title: Your friend in the AC business.
text: Tri City AC & Heat is a family-owned and operated business, and it has been keeping homes and businesses across Pasadena comfortable since 1982. Founder David Moore retired in 2003, and Jeff Hurley, a long-time technician, bought the operation and still runs it.

Our foundation is honesty, integrity and quality workmanship. We treat every customer like a friend, we take the time to explain what is actually wrong, and we always try to fix a problem before we talk about replacing anything. We specialize in residential air conditioning and heating as well as duct work, and we also sell parts over the counter.

Forty years in has taught us that systems fail at inconvenient hours, which is why we answer emergency calls. It has also earned us an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau. From preventative maintenance to emergency service to parts sales, you'll be sittin' pretty with Tri City.
